question: The West Bengal government has launched 'Paray Shikshalaya’ programme. This initiative supports _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Open air **__**__classroom__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Paray Shikshalaya’ programme**

 
 
• ​The** West Bengal state government** unveiled its **open-air learning project**, known as **"Paray Shikshalaya,"** on February 7.
 
• The **state government's goal is to provide classes I through VII in elementary education** in every neighbourhood within the state.
 
• This new campaign aims to encourage kids to pursue their education, especially those who have stopped attending school as a result of the Covid-19 epidemic issue. 
 
• This **project would involve both primary school teachers and paraprofessionals.** Children in Classes 1–5 will receive an elementary education from them.
